caption: The drawing depicts a single pig sitting on its haunches, facing slightly to the left. The pig has a rounded body with visible folds of skin, especially around the neck and legs. The coloration consists of a blend of earthy tones, primarily yellowish-brown, with accents of darker green, brown, gray, and hints of orange. The pig's snout, eyes, and inner ears are defined with darker shading, while highlights on the back and sides suggest a glossy texture. The entire figure is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Toy bank: Pig
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
